name: Wild Black Zeera (Kala Zeera)
note: Wild black cumin, picked by hand on the high slopes. Our rarest product.
story: Kala zeera grows wild and takes hours to collect. A pinch changes a whole dish.
uses: Temper dal and rice with it
why: This is what gives Kashmiri biryani and yakhni their deep, smoky flavour. At home it's also the old fix for a heavy stomach after a rich meal. (It's not kalonji, which is a different seed.)
